## Target / coordinate

Generation, game, release, dump, project, or other semantic coordinate:

## Identity claim

What identity, relationship, or correction should be established?

## Source and provenance

Record the strongest available source references, repository revisions, publication/release metadata, filenames, hashes, headers, catalog identifiers, or other provenance.

## Evidence

Hashes, offsets, symbols, byte comparisons, screenshots, tables, commands, citations, or other reproducible evidence:

## Uncertainty

What is still unknown, inferred, conflicting, or awaiting independent confirmation?

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The semantic coordinate is explicit.
- [ ] Provenance is recorded.
- [ ] Hypothesis is separated from observed fact.
- [ ] Conflicting identities are documented rather than silently collapsed.
- [ ] Verification level can be justified from the supplied evidence.
- [ ] Shared coordinates are aligned with Tsubaki when applicable.
- [ ] No complete playable ROM image is attached or committed.
